# dial

> 3 React components and 307 design tokens. dial-react is not on npm yet. Install the release tarball (pnpm run release:pack writes it to release/): npm install /path/to/release/dial-react-0.0.0.tgz, then import 'dial-react/all.css' once at the root.

## Components

- Container: A starter layout primitive with no form of its own, which Phase 1 restates in this system's own terms. `import { Container } from 'dial-react';`
- Grid: A starter layout primitive with no form of its own, which Phase 1 restates in this system's own terms. `import { Grid, GridItem } from 'dial-react';`
- Stack: A starter layout primitive with no form of its own, which Phase 1 restates in this system's own terms. `import { Stack } from 'dial-react';`
